description: This PHP source file contains functions related to handling attachments in the TestLink project, including retrieving attachment info, storing attachments in session, validating attachment IDs, managing file uploads, and deleting attachments.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfos
methods.description: Retrieves attachment information for a given object or repository, optionally storing it in session.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfosFrom
methods.description: Retrieves attachment information from an object implementing getAttachmentInfos method, optionally storing it in session.

methods.name: storeAttachmentsInSession
methods.description: Stores attachment info array into PHP session, either replacing or merging with existing data.

methods.name: checkAttachmentID
methods.description: Validates if a given attachment ID exists within the last stored attachment infos in session.

methods.name: fileUploadManagement
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, inserting it as an attachment, and logging the event.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment by ID after optional session validation and logs the deletion.
